maya: Heads-up — on reranker-v2 quant bring-up I saw an ndcg@10 drop on the dev harness (long-docs slice) vs fp16: 0.314 -> 0.288 (-0.026). Prod sanity sample didn't show the drop. anyone seen this pattern?
liam: Could be an input-format/priming mismatch between the harness and prod traffic. we sometimes add a 'RERANK:' prefix in offline harness which changes tokenization. quantization can amplify those tiny shifts.
devon: Yup. I hit this before — int8 made tiny tokenization boundary changes actually matter. Try a stripped-prefix run and compare.
sara: I can run that. plan: run parity experiments (fp16 vs int8) with/without prefix + same batching/seed. command I'll use: `./experiments/run_eval.sh --model reranker-v2 --quant int8 --slice long-docs --strip-prefix --seed 42 --batch 1`
maya: Also capture mrr@10 + per-query delta histogram. if it's long-tail only maybe sample noise.
eval-bot: eval-bot: Quick sweep finished: int8 (harness with prefix) ndcg@10 0.286, fp16 0.315 — delta -0.029. details: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4987
liam: can you paste the input formatting config used in harness vs prod? i'm worried about whitespace collapsing and explicit newline tokens.
maya: config snippet:
```ninput_template = "RERANK: {query}\nCANDIDATES:\n{docs}"
max_seq = 512
tokenizer = 'hf/bert-tokenizer-v2'
```
If harness uses that and prod uses `"{query}\n{docs}"` we can get tokenization shifts.
devon: Let's run these three experiments: 1) harness+prefix fp16 vs int8; 2) harness-no-prefix fp16 vs int8; 3) prodlike-no-prefix fp16 vs int8 (kvpack on/off). Also disable warmup cache. I'll schedule them.
sara: :thumbsup: scheduling now, will share job ids. if delta only shows up with prefix, we should normalize input formatting in onboarding checklist.
maya: Agreed. Also add a unit test in the eval harness to detect >1% ndcg drop after quantization on a 1k seeded subset.
liam: also track candidate ordering stability (Spearman) alongside ndcg/mrr.
sara: Job IDs: 65421 (harness-prefix-int8), 65422 (harness-no-prefix-int8), 65423 (prodlike-no-prefix-int8). ETA ~45m.
devon: I'll rerun baseline fp16 on the same jobs for parity.
eval-bot: eval-bot: Job 65421 finished. summary: ndcg@10: fp16 0.316 | int8 0.289 | delta -0.027. mrr@10 delta -0.015. per-query mean delta skewed to short queries (<=20 tokens).
maya: interesting — now skewed to short queries, not long-docs. maybe prefix interacts with truncation/padding so short queries get different token boundaries.
liam: good call. add per-seqlen bins: <=20, 21-100, >100 and report ndcg/mrr per bin.
sara: Will attach per-bin table when jobs finish.
devon: if formatting turns out to be root cause we should add explicit input_template enforcement to the onboarding doc + a canonical harness script.
maya: i'll draft the PR for onboarding checklist and add the unit test.
sara: thanks — i'll upload logs and per-bin CSVs once all jobs are done.
